audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer win[0..6] said Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri. The page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Karma has Mantra from level 1 with no skill point, so RQ Inner Flame exists before Ahri's Charm (12s, 60 mana) does; Ahri has no ultimate until 6, when Spirit Rush (140/120/100s, three casts) gives her a dash that closes past Karma's 675 W tether and sets up Charm from angles Karma cannot pre-shield.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides realigned to the content layer and the packet levelChart: Karma 1-3, Skill 4-5, Ahri 6 / first item / two+ items, with each why rewritten to match its new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text claimed Karma has "a longer effective range than Ahri's Orb of Deception".
audit.why: Inner Flame is 950 range; Orb of Deception is 970. Ahri outranges Karma's Q, so the level 1-3 advantage comes from Mantra being available without a skill point, not from range.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text around Mantra-at-level-1 versus Charm not yet existing. Kept the four spikes: early Mantra window, Spirit Rush at 6, her first burst item, late pick threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Orb of Deception returns as true damage, Essence Theft heals her every 9 minions, and Spirit Rush lands her inside Karma's 675 W tether leash.
audit.why: Riot's text on Ahri Q says it deals magic damage outbound and true damage on the way back, so stacking MR does not blunt half the poke. Essence Theft heals on every 9th minion killed, which is why even-HP trades drift her way. Karma's W tethers at 675 and roots if the leash is not broken, and Ahri's R is a 450-range dash, so a dash-in leaves her inside tether range.
audit.corrected: Stated all three: true-damage return in dontsFull[0].d, Essence Theft sustain in dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.carry, tether-catches-the-dash in dosFull[2].d and breakdown.late. Added real cooldowns (Charm 12s, Fox-Fire 9->5s, Spirit Rush 140/120/100s, Karma E 10->8s) to breakdown.cooldowns, which previously contained no digit at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six titles and four report entries called Ahri "he/his/him"; three bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Ahri is she/her per champ-gender.js. The bleed bullets promised one thing in the title and explained another in the body.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; the three bled bodies replaced with content that matches their titles.
